title.narrative: Territorios que resisten: Agua y resiliencia climática

description.narrative:
The project "Territories that resist: Water and climate resilience in Bolívar and Valle del Cauca", led by Climalab, will be implemented for 39 months in the municipalities of María La Baja and San Martín de Loba (Bolívar) and Jamundí (Valle del Cauca), in rural and ethnic territories vulnerable to climate change. Its objective is to strengthen community climate resilience and Climalab's institutional capacities, from a focus on climate justice, transformative gender, ancestry, youth and peace. 200 people will be accompanied directly (120 women and 80 men, 40% of them young people), through training processes, implementation of sustainable agri-food systems and nature-based conservation actions. In addition, 60 community leaders will be strengthened and spaces for local and national political advocacy will be promoted, such as the annual event "Climate with the Country".
The project will also consolidate Climalab's organizational structure, through a Wellbeing and Human Talent Plan, a Monitoring and Learning Observatory, and an Institutional Sustainability Strategy.
